verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage markets an in-product Customer Screening and Ongoing Monitoring agent that auto-remediates level 1 alerts and escalates high-risk or complex cases to human reviewers. A case audit trail endpoint exists, but no evidence shows the agent records its rationale for each match decision. missing for 10: documented agent-recorded rationale per match decision, first-party docs (beyond marketing pages) on how the agent reviews matches, independent or hands-on corroboration
